question: How is the knowing-and-doing power characterized in relation to bonds and liberated selves?
premises: In ordinary states the power is manifested through bonds
In liberated selves the same power is identified as knowing and doing
inference: Therefore the power manifested by bonds is called the knowing-and-doing power of the liberated
plain_english: The power manifested by the bonds is called the knowing-and-doing power of the liberated.
